name: rogue-legacy
features: initial 4:3 metrics refresh before the first playable room
4:3 splash, title, centered options, and pause layouts
expanded 1220x890 map and teleporter surface with 990-line labels and legend
recognized porter Telegram credit and developer-promo neutralization when present

notes: RogueLegacy.Android is resolved by name from assemblies.manifest instead of assuming one descriptor index.
Every required 4:3 IL and user-string target accepts only its audited original or patched value and is safe to finish from a mixed state.
Porter, Telegram, and promotional targets are source-specific: recognized copies are neutralized, while absent or unfamiliar copies are preserved silently.
The shared optional branding cleanup remains responsible for recognized APKVision runtime wrappers.
